items.title: Kalshi's Expansion to Include Stock Trading
items.summary: Bloomberg's Bobby Allyn joins Scarlet Fu and Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Crypto." Kalshi is preparing to offer stock trading on its app after acquiring a brokerage firm that will allow the platform to continue expanding beyond its origins as a prediction market.

items.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Sells $85 Million in Nvidia, Buys $40 Million in Crypto Stocks

items.title: Strategy Is Down 28% in a Month. Can MSTR Stock Hit Cantor Fitzgerald’s $208 Target by 2030?

items.title: Wells Fargo doubles down on bitcoin ETF, and Chase goes down, but bitcoin stays
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Wells Fargo doubling down on the BlackRock (BLK) bitcoin (BTC-USD) ETF, Chase (JPM) going down while crypto stayed up, and the Supreme Court rejecting a crypto bank's bid for Fed payment access.

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
